subject: general
question:
**A sentence is provided in direct speech. From the four given options, choose the one that most accurately conveys the sentence in its corresponding indirect speech.**

Rita said, "Please close the window."

options.text: Rita asked to close the window.
Rita said to close the window.
Rita requested that the window is closed.
Rita requested to close the window.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indirect Speech:** Rita requested to close the window.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Please close the window" becomes "requested to close the window"**
 
 
• The word "please" indicates a polite request.
 
• The reporting verb is converted to "requested" to reflect politeness.
 
• The phrase "to close the window" directly conveys the action being requested.
 
 
 
 
 
• **Punctuation and Format:**
 
 
• Direct speech is converted to indirect speech without quotation marks.
 
• The verb "requested" is followed by the infinitive "to close" to properly convey the polite request.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"Rita requested to close the window."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1:** "Rita asked to close the window."
 
 
• The word "asked" is not as polite as "requested" and does not fully convey the tone of the original sentence.
 
 
 
• **Option 2:** "Rita said to close the window."
 
 
• The word "said" is neutral and does not reflect the polite request implied by "please."
 
 
 
• **Option 3:** "Rita requested that the window is closed."
 
 
• The structure is grammatically incorrect; the phrase "the window is closed" is not the appropriate indirect speech conversion.
